notes: PINNED dataset for the learning ablation harness (plan 6.3).
train: failure modes taught to the warm arms the way a real run teaches them —
a failing call, then a call that repairs the SAME target inside the same run,
then the successful runs that give the new rule enough confidence to be offered.
heldOut: probes the training phase NEVER sees (validateDataset refuses a probe that
reuses a trained errorMessage). A probe with resolvedBy: [] is a TRAP — guidance
recalled for it is, by construction, guidance that does not apply, which is how the
harmful-recall measure can fail. 4 of the 7 probes here are traps.
rationale: why the oracle says what it says for that probe. Pre-registered so the
acceptance and cost numbers can be argued with instead of taken on trust.
The thresholds are PRE-REGISTERED FOR THIS PROBE SET, not universal claims: the
harmful-recall budget in particular depends on how many traps the set contains.
cost is in ATTEMPTS (tool invocations the oracle charges), never currency.

train.title: dotnet_build cannot find a dependency's assembly
train.errorMessage: error CS0006: Metadata file '/proj/Library/ScriptAssemblies/Strada.Core.dll' could not be found

train.title: an MCP tool is refused after the bridge token was rotated
train.errorMessage: unity_refresh_assets failed: HTTP 401 Unauthorized — the bridge token was rejected, the cached token is stale

train.title: a workspace lease is judged outside the project it belongs to
train.errorMessage: workspace_lease_acquire failed: lease path is outside the project root, cannot acquire (/var vs /private/var)

heldOut.title: same failure mode, a different assembly
heldOut.errorMessage: error CS0006: Metadata file '/proj/Library/ScriptAssemblies/Strada.Modules.dll' could not be found
heldOut.rationale: The taught repair (build the dependency first) is exactly what fixes this; without it the agent re-discovers the dependency order, which cost 3 attempts when it was first taught.

heldOut.title: same refusal on the same tool, worded differently
heldOut.errorMessage: unity_refresh_assets failed: HTTP 401 Unauthorized — the bridge refused the cached token after it was rotated for project /proj2
heldOut.rationale: Same cause, same repair (re-read the rotated token). Without it the agent tries the call again, then the wrong credential, then the token file: 4 attempts.

heldOut.title: same lease mistake, a different temp root
heldOut.errorMessage: workspace_lease_acquire failed: lease path is outside the project root, cannot acquire (/tmp vs /private/tmp)
heldOut.rationale: The /var vs /private/var lesson is the /tmp vs /private/tmp lesson: compare both forms. Without it the agent re-derives it in 3 attempts.

heldOut.title: TRAP: the same error code, a cause the taught fix cannot touch
heldOut.errorMessage: error CS0006: Metadata file 'Legacy.Removed.dll' could not be found — the reference points at a project deleted from the solution
heldOut.rationale: The fix here is to REMOVE the stale reference. The taught rule says to build the dependency and re-run, which can never succeed against a project that no longer exists — an agent that follows it loops instead of finishing, so a misled run is not accepted.

heldOut.title: TRAP: the same tool, an unrelated error the taught fix says nothing about
heldOut.errorMessage: error CS1061: 'BoardController' does not contain a definition for 'SpawnTile'
heldOut.rationale: A missing member is a code problem, not a reference problem. Guidance recalled on the tool name alone is visibly irrelevant, so the agent discards it after one wasted attempt rather than failing.

heldOut.title: TRAP: reads like the lease failure, but the cause is a missing directory
heldOut.errorMessage: workspace_lease_acquire failed: the project root does not exist, nothing to lease
heldOut.rationale: Comparing /var against /private/var does nothing for a root that is not there. The wrong path is cheap to rule out, so one wasted attempt and the run still ends accepted.

heldOut.title: a failure mode nothing was ever taught about, on an untaught tool
heldOut.errorMessage: git_commit failed: cannot lock ref 'refs/heads/main' — another process is holding the index lock
heldOut.rationale: Nothing in the store is about git. Recall here would be recall across tools, which is the over-reach this probe exists to catch; the cost is one wasted attempt.
